asr_text: I have quite a few people lately ask me why I am not voting for Kamala Harris. As we've all probably experienced and felt at the grocery store, inflation has gone up like crazy. I think everybody can feel it but housing is already an issue for people that live here legally but to let such a large group of people just into the country illegally, no vetting, no understanding of the constitution, no assimilation to what it means to be an American, just letting them come on in. I think it's pretty obvious that that's going to cause issues. Everybody that I know does not want more of what we've experienced the last 4 years. We don't want heightened grocery prices. We don't want more illegal immigrants coming over the border. And so, because all of these reasons and honestly more, I will not be casting a vote for Kamala Harris.
